# openmetadata_workflow_definition (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata workflow definition by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_workflow_definition" "contract_approval" {
  fully_qualified_name = "contract_approval"
}

output "contract_approval_workflow_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_workflow_definition.contract_approval.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Workflow definition fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Workflow definition UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `deployed` (Boolean) Whether the workflow definition is deployed on the server.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `edges` (String) Workflow edges as a JSON array.
- `name` (String) Workflow definition name.
- `nodes` (String) Workflow nodes as a JSON array.
- `store_stage_status` (Boolean) Whether the workflow stores the status of every stage it runs.
- `suspended` (Boolean) Whether the workflow definition is suspended on the server.
- `trigger` (String) Workflow trigger as a JSON object.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
